ideas.title: The Rise of Ponzi Schemes: An Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent rise in Ponzi schemes, including the Woodhill Capital case
questions: What are the common characteristics of Ponzi schemes?
ideas.insight: The recent increase in Ponzi schemes indicates a need for greater investor awareness and regulation. This story would explore the causes and consequences of these schemes.

ideas.title: Child Care Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the growing issue of child care fraud, including potential solutions
questions: What are the common types of child care fraud?

ideas.insight: The rise in child care fraud indicates a need for greater oversight and regulation in the healthcare industry. This story would explore the causes and consequences of this issue.
